input.subject: PRE-LAUNCH | The Berry, Williamsburg — sales launching this fall
input.bodyText:
Brokers,

Excited to share a first look at The Berry, a new 88-unit waterfront condominium coming to 55 Berry St, Williamsburg. Sales have NOT launched yet — we're building our interest list ahead of a fall launch.

Studios through 3BRs planned, with a full amenity package. Pricing to be released closer to launch. Register your qualified buyers now for priority preview access.

More to come — reserve your spot for the broker preview.

Tomas Vega
Compass Development Marketing Group
